notes.title: Version 0.0.30 and Early Access!
notes.notes:
v0.0.30 includes a set of basic game mechanics (combat system, crafting, building, dungeons, dialogue system, character leveling system) and the following game items:

 51 items to buy in your game world
 32 items of equipment available for crafting
 21 additional interactive items
